Subject: KEK rotation evidence we requested (June 18)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the call earlier. CedarBank completed the KEK rotation on our tenant yesterday (June 18) and our internal auditors have asked for a tight package of artifacts to validate the handover and operator controls. Can Redwood provide the following items by EOD Jun 20?

- Snapshot of the HSM operator audit trail for the rotation window (2028-06-18 02:00 -> 2028-06-18 06:00 UTC)
- KEK rotation manifest (who initiated, key IDs, wrapped/unwrapped ops)
- Operator acknowledgement form for the ceremony
- Verification that wrapped key material never left HSM boundary (logs or attestation)

We understand some artifacts may be redacted. If so, provide the redaction notes and a short explanation of what was removed. Also, please reference any DocuSign/Drive links so we can attach to our SOC/ISO evidence binder.

Attachment: cedar_rotation_request_20280619.pdf

Appreciate a quick confirmation on the plan and ETA.

Best,
Alice Lam
Sr. Security Ops Manager
CedarBank Corp

Alice,

Thanks — received and we can deliver. Quick plan:

1) Irene will extract the HSM operator audit trail and produce a filtered snapshot covering the window you specified.
2) We will assemble a rotation manifest CSV (key IDs, wrap ops, initiating principal, timestamps).
3) We will include an operator acknowledgement PDF signed by the on-call HSM operator and our internal observer notes.
4) Where low-level telemetry must be redacted for security reasons we will include a redaction manifest explaining the fields removed.

Irene / Marissa / Neha: can you confirm availability to ship the artifacts by EOD 2028-06-20 PST? If we need more time we should flag it now.

Also, do you want the artifacts uploaded to the Drive folder you linked in the ask, or would you prefer a secure SFTP transfer? If Drive, please confirm the folder and access scope.

I can also set up a 30-min review session tomorrow afternoon to walk through the artifacts if your audit team wants to validate live.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
